title: Among customers who paid in Czech koruna (CZK), identify the segment with t
question: Among customers who paid in Czech koruna (CZK), identify the segment with the lowest total consumption. For that segment, find the top-spending customer based on transaction prices, and return their average price per single item purchased along with their currency.

prediction.sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT XCL_001, XCL_002, XCL_003
    FROM customers
    WHERE XCL_003 = 'CZK'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_002 AS segment, SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM czk_customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM czk_customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item, c.XCL_003 AS currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT XCL_001, XCL_002, XCL_003
    FROM customers
    WHERE XCL_003 = 'CZK'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_002 AS segment, SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM czk_customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM czk_customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item, c.XCL_003 AS currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013

Final aggregation: AVG(transactions_1k.XCL_018) computes the average price per transaction for the selected customer, which aligns with 'average price per single item purchased' given XCL_018 is the transaction total.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH czk AS (
  SELECT XCL_001, XCL_002, XCL_003 FROM customers WHERE XCL_003='CZK'
),
seg AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_002 AS segment, SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS tc
  FROM czk c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001=ym.XCL_019
  GROUP BY c.XCL_002 ORDER BY tc ASC LIMIT 1
),
top AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001, SUM(t.XCL_018) AS spend
  FROM czk c JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001=t.XCL_013
  WHERE c.XCL_002=(SELECT segment FROM seg)
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001 ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price, c.XCL_003 AS currency
FROM top
JOIN customers c ON top.XCL_001=c.XCL_001
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001=t.XCL_013

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_003 AS segment,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_003
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_spending
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
      AND c.XCL_003 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013
    ORDER BY total_spending DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item,
    t.XCL_012 AS currency
FROM transactions_1k t
WHERE t.XCL_013 = (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customer)
  AND t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
